about: MontClip's own words for Cindy keys whose Cindy wording does not fit MontClip, laid over cindy-strings.json. The four permission modes are MontClip's (#83); the stand-in useAgentCapabilities gives them under Cindy's ids plan / ask / auto / bypassPermissions.

ask.label: 手动
ask.description: 改项目前先问你；撤不回的每次都问

auto.label: 自动
auto.description: 能撤销的直接做，撤不回的先问你

bypassPermissions.label: Yolo
bypassPermissions.description: 全都直接做，不再问你；往外发的内容照样先给你看

ask.label: Manual
ask.description: Asks before changing the project; asks every time for anything that can't be undone

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Does what can be undone; asks before what can't

bypassPermissions.label: Yolo
bypassPermissions.description: Does everything without asking; anything sent out is still shown to you first
